title: CAD Example Reference Locked by Default
description: The reference in the CAD example should by default be locked same as puzzle 3d (concrete-forest references ship locked: true). Change CAD example reference creation so references are locked by default.
summary: CAD concrete-forest example references now default to locked, matching puzzle 3d. Changed `forest_references_for_model_definitions` from `locked: false` to `locked: true`, and extended `forest_references_sit_at_authored_slab_elevation` to assert the lock. Verified with `cargo test -p cad-plugin forest_references_sit_at_authored_slab_elevation`.
